extracted.intended_audience: eRA Commons users — Signing Officials (SO), Principal Investigators (PI), delegated ASST users, and institutional grants administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Procedures, requirements, and UI guidance for using the eRA Commons Status module to track eSubmissions, view Status Information, manage errors/warnings, perform SO-only actions (reject, verify, re-assign), and access related documents (PRAM, administrative supplements, additions for review).

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-business-day application viewing window
rubrics_metrics.description: After submitting an application, you have a two-business-day application viewing window to check the application and reject and revise it. After the viewing window has elapsed, the application automatically moves forward to agency staff unless explicitly rejected in eRA Commons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the application is submitted just before the due date, the viewing window lasts only until the due date/time and thus may be less than two days. Administrative supplements may bypass this window (see Bypassing the 2-Business-Day Application Viewing Window for Administrative Supplements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Errors vs warnings behavior at eSubmission
rubrics_metrics.description: Errors will stop the submission process and require a change/corrected application. Warnings will not stop processing but must be checked to ensure they do not apply to your application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Show Prior Errors and Warnings action or open the Status Information (Application ID link) to view errors/warnings displayed in a yellow or pink box during the two-day review period.

rubrics_metrics.name: SO-only authority to reject an eApplication
rubrics_metrics.description: Only Signing Officials (SO users) can request to reject the eSubmission of an application. The application must not have been previously verified or rejected by the SO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rejecting updates the application status to Refused. The SO must enter a required comment (which becomes part of the rejection email), click Reject, confirm on the Reject Confirmation popup, and the contact PI will receive an email notification that the SO has rejected the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Steps to reject an eApplication (SO)
rubrics_metrics.description: To reject an eApplication: log in as SO, navigate to Status -> Recent/Pending eSubmissions, locate applications with eSubmission Status of Pending Verification, use the three-dot ellipsis menu to select Reject eApplication, enter a required comment, and confirm rejection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Reject eApplication screen and Reject Confirmation popup must be used; the required comment is sent to the PI. See How Does an SO Reject the eApplication? for screen images and detailed steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bypassing the two-business-day viewing window for administrative supplements
rubrics_metrics.description: SOs can bypass the two-business-day viewing window for non-competitive administrative supplement applications so the application is immediately routed to receipt and referral staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only administrative supplement applications submitted in the last two days include the Verify action. Use Status -> Recent/Pending eSubmissions, find the application, select Verify from the three-dot menu, confirm in the popup (which warns the application cannot be revised), and the application is immediately released for processing. PI (with cc to SO) receives an email notifying of bypass and submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify action limitations and consequences
rubrics_metrics.description: The Verify action makes the administrative supplement immediately available to receipt and referral staff and cannot be undone; the application cannot be revised after verification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A popup confirms intent and warns irreversibility; clicking Yes completes verification. After agency processing, the PI typically receives email notifications of rejections or acceptance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Re-assign Award availability and constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: The Re-assign Award functionality is available only to signing officials from grantee organizations classified as Institutions of Higher Education and moves awards only within departments/components of the same organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This tool cannot be used to create new departments/components and does NOT move an award between organizations. Assignments are immediate in eRA Commons and will be visible in RePORTER on the following Monday. You can search only for current and future fiscal years, for awarded grants or pending type 5 grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Re-assign Award process rules
rubrics_metrics.description: To re-assign awards: log in as SO, Status -> Re-Assign Award, enter search criteria, select one or more checkboxes for awards on the current results page, click Next, choose destination School/Department (only existing ones shown), review the summary, and click Submit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can move all visible awards on a page at one time but cannot combine selections from non-visible result pages; to move grants on other pages, go to those pages and repeat the process. The success popup offers navigation back to Status or to re-assign more awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: eSubmission tracking indicators and actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the eSubmission Status column to determine if an application status is 'eSubmission Error', 'Rejected', or 'Pending Verification' and take appropriate actions (e.g., Show Prior Errors and Warnings, Reject eApplication).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For 'eSubmission Error' use Show Prior Errors and Warnings; for 'Pending Verification' you can open Status Information via the linked Application ID to view submission errors/warnings, or the SO can Reject eApplication from the three-dot menu.

rubrics_metrics.name: Show Prior Errors and Warnings action
rubrics_metrics.description: Selecting Show Prior Errors and Warnings (from the three-dot ellipsis) opens the Errors/Warnings for Prior eSubmissions screen and lists validation or other errors that occurred upon submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This action appears only if there are errors/warnings; use the linked Application ID or the Show Errors and Warnings button/column to view the messages. Errors must be addressed via change/corrected application.

rubrics_metrics.name: PI Status view options and access scope
rubrics_metrics.description: PIs see a landing page with Recent/Pending eSubmissions, List of Applications/Awards, and Search by Grants.gov Tracking Num; the Status module lets PIs review submission status, pending review, review outcome, Advisory Council action, and award status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PIs can grant ASST role users access to the Status module; ASST users can view status results as the PI but will not have access to the action links in the Action column. Refer to Direct Delegations for more detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search criteria for Recent/Pending eSubmissions (SO)
rubrics_metrics.description: Search options include Grants.gov Tracking #, Accession Number, eSubmission Status (All, Pending Verification, or Rejected), and Received Date Range.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter date ranges using the calendar icon and choose dates; Grants.gov Tracking # is assigned on electronic submission and Accession Number is assigned before an NIH grant number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search result table tools and navigation
rubrics_metrics.description: In search results you can use the three-dot ellipsis next to Award/Application ID for actions, Grid tool to set visible rows, page number links/navigation arrows to move through pages, and Export icons to export to Excel or PDF.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To select all visible search results, click the checkbox at the top of the column. If the number of records exceeds the screen, use the table navigation to access remaining records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status Information - contents and screen tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Status Information (opened via Application Number link) aggregates grant info and links; sections include Contacts (SRO, GMS, PO), Latest Update, eRA Service Desk, Application Information, Status, Other Relevant Documents, Additions for Review, Review, Institute/Center Assignment, Status History, Awards, Reference Letters, and optionally Award Terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Screen Tools: Filter (searches screen content but not left sections Contacts/Latest Update/eRA Service Desk), Expand All/Collapse All (affects all sections except application information), and Print (prints all content regardless of collapsed state). Individual sections may be expanded/collapsed separately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Information and Status data fields
rubrics_metrics.description: The Application Information section shows Application number, Status (link to era_status_codes.pdf for list), Project Title, PI Name, NIH Appl. ID, and Application ID. The Status section includes current status, last status update date, PI name, institution name, school name, school category, division/department, proposal receipt date, proposal title, project period begin/end date, current award notice date, application source, eApplication status, and FOA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: 'NFP' (no further processing) is added in Proposal Title to indicate the application will not be referred for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Relevant Documents linkage
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Relevant Documents contains links to grant-related documents (availability depends on application/grant), such as Abstract, Administrative Supplement(s), Appendix files, Closeout FRAM, e-Application, Final Invention Statement, Final RPPR, Notices of Grant Award (PDF), Progress Report Face Page, PRAM, Summary Statement, Relinquishing Statement(s), xTrain items, and others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clicking a listed document opens the item (e.g., PRAM opens as a PDF with headers for each submission). Multiple submissions are shown most recent first.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additions for Review - allowed groups and metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Additions for Review contains supplemental documents uploaded to support the application and displays the Group (category), Document (file name as link), Grant/Subproject (award number), and Date (upload date). Categories include Updated Pages; Supplemental Material; Collaboration Letters; Modified Budget Pages; Accepted Publication; Biographical Sketches; and Other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uploaded documents can be viewed, updated, and saved. These items are made available to the applicant when the SRO uploads them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative Supplements - definition and display
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative Supplements are requests for (or the award of) additional funds during a current project period to provide for an increase in costs due to unforeseen circumstances. The Administrative Supplements screen provides read-only access to supplements created for the grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Administrative Supplements table includes identifying information (grant number link to Supplement Request PDF), Accession Number, Supplement Status, Submitted Date, and Comments for Grantee. The Administrative Supplement History screen provides a read-only history of supplements for the grant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Viewing PRAM and Public Access PRAM via Status Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Users can view submitted Progress Report Additional Materials (PRAM) via Status Information under Other Relevant Documents. The PRAM PDF includes a header for each submission followed by uploaded documents; multiple submissions are separated with the most recent first.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agency-specific note: Department of Commerce (DOC) — Public Access PRAM is not applicable for DOC awards. Steps: use Status to look up award, click award/application ID, then click the PRAM link under Other Relevant Documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Errors viewing methods for PIs
rubrics_metrics.description: From PI search results, use 'Show Errors and Warnings' button or click the Accession Number for Pending Verification applications to open Status Information where submission errors/warnings are displayed at the top during the two-day review period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform the following from the search results: check eSubmission Status for 'eSubmission Error', 'Pending Verification', or 'Rejected' and then use either the Show Errors and Warnings button or open Status Information to view messages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review subsection content availability
rubrics_metrics.description: The Review section of Status Information may include Application details (Award Document Number, FSR Accepted Code, Snap Indicator Code, Impact Score (PI only), Percentile (PI only), Early Stage Investigator Eligible, New Investigator Eligible, Eligible for FFATA Reporting), Study Section details (Scientific Review Group, Council Meeting Date, Meeting Date/Time, Study Roster link if available), and Advisory Council meeting info.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If Study Roster is available, a View Meeting Roster link opens a PDF of the meeting roster for reviewers of the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference Letters metadata display
rubrics_metrics.description: If reference letters are associated with the application, the Reference Letter(s) section displays Referee Name, Organization Affiliation, Department, Email, and Submitted date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PIs can also view reference letter information in the Reference Letter section of their Personal Profile; refer to the Reference Letters topic for more information.
